collection.description: A child asks why a friend is resting instead of playing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why (friend) is resting instead of playing.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a healer, explains that germs and other causes can make bodies unwell.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that sickness is not a punishment.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) offers a kind message without visiting when contagious.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) helps bring clean water under adult guidance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) distinguishes comforting rituals from treatments with observable effects.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) learns that rest and care can matter alongside beliefs.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) explains that not every illness has a clear cause.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) understands that adults sometimes need time to learn more.
